messages:
maria_cs: Quick pulse — onboarding ingestion for ~34 trial tenants experienced a backlog this morning (08:10–10:05 PDT). I'm concerned about conversion/renewal risk for ~7 high-touch accounts. Need customer communications + an outreach plan. @sre_oncall any immediate ETA on root cause and mitigation?

jake_se: Got it. Can you share the tenant list so I can flag renewals and prep exec outreach?

sre_oncall: Investigating. Initial summary: intermittent S3 5xx + our continuous-batching loop retried too aggressively, compounding load. We pushed a backpressure mitigation at 09:45 which throttled retries; throughput back near baseline by 10:20. Full remediation (PR with exponential backoff + tighter KV cache gating) ETA ~24h.

lee_engineering: Confirming. PR linked in #eng-runtime, tests running. If green, can promote patch to canary in ~2h. Long term: add circuit-breaker metrics and alert.

olivia_csm: Drafted customer-facing language for two segments. Pasting below — please review for tone and credits.

olivia_csm: ```
High-touch template (for named renewals / pilots)
Subject: Important update on your ingestion job — immediate help available
Hi <Customer Name>,
We wanted to let you know we observed delays in the onboarding ingestion pipeline this morning that impacted your recent data upload. Our team has applied an emergency mitigation to restore throughput and we can re-run your ingestion on demand.
What we did: applied traffic backpressure and prioritized stalled workloads; investigating a full fix.
Next steps for you: reply to this thread and we will schedule a dedicated re-run and a 1-month service credit for the impacted data window.
We’ll follow up with a short post-incident note and offer an office-hours slot to walk through any questions.
Thanks for your patience — we know timing here matters for your rollout.
Best,
<Your CSM>

Low-touch template (trial / self-serve)
Subject: Onboarding delay — we fixed the immediate issue
Hi there,
You may have seen a delay in your recent data upload earlier today. Our mitigation restored throughput and your workspace should be back to normal. If you need us to re-run ingestion or want a walkthrough, reply here and we’ll help.
We’re issuing a 1-month credit to affected trial accounts and following up with a short RCA.
Thanks,
The Redwood Inference Team
```

maria_cs: Love the templates. Add two small items: (1) explicit renewal-bridge phrasing for high-touch: "we will prioritize your activation to avoid renewal impact" and (2) a short feedback ask after the re-run with a 1‑question survey link so we capture friction points.

alan_support_bot: Created support tickets for the affected tenants: CS-8172..CS-8205. Automated follow-up emails queued, and a private tag added: "onboard-ingest-2026-03-23".

jake_se: I’ll draft the exec brief for sales leadership and include affected ARR and renewal dates. Maria — can you drop tenant list before 11:00 so I can finish?

olivia_csm: Updated high-touch copy to include renewal-bridge language and survey. New text pushed below: 

olivia_csm: ```
Hi <Customer Name>,
We applied an emergency mitigation and can prioritize a re-run to get you activated this week — we’ll do that free of charge to avoid any renewal or launch impact. After the re-run, a short 1-question feedback form helps us make sure the experience is smooth.
Best, <Your CSM>
```

lee_engineering: One ask from eng: for any re-runs, include the original upload ID and approximate timestamp so we don't duplicate. Also please tell customers we’ve scheduled a post-mortem and will share an RCA summary within 48 hours.

maria_cs: Noted. Action items: 1) Olivia finalizes outbound templates (due 11:00) 2) Jake prepares exec brief + impacted ARR numbers (due noon) 3) Support runs re-runs on demand with upload ID (ongoing) 4) Engineering posts RCA draft within 48h 5) Offer 1-month credit to impacted trials and prioritized activation for high-touch accounts.

jake_se: Copy. I'll escalate any at-risk renewals to AE owners after your list.

sre_oncall: Logging timeline to incident tracker. Will ping when long-term PR merged and deployed.

maria_cs: Thanks everyone. Once Olivia drops the final text, I'll start a segmented send (top 7 high-touch via 1:1 email + the rest via automated CS queue). We'll capture responses in the CS tracker and surface renewals that look vulnerable.

olivia_csm: Final copy is up and I added the survey link: https://redwood.company/survey/onboard-2026. Sending to top-7 after Maria confirms list. :wave:

maria_cs: Tenant list uploaded to the shared drive and to the tracker. Going to run the high-touch send now and tag AEs. Will update thread with outbound time and any replies. :100:
